exposure: implementation of evidence-based strategies to reduce bacterial load
Before and after implementation of infection prevention initiatives
Implementation of evidence-based strategies to reduce bacterial load
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section at Broome Hospital, Australia, between January 1 and May 1 in 2019 and 2021.
finding: The study found a statistically significant reduction in post-caesarean infection rates after the implementation of evidence-based infection prevention initiatives.
